args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (FIN-212), but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring said ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

This change switches `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. Now 2.665 rounds to 2.66 and 2.675 rounds to 2.68.

CI: ci-0001 passed on 08d3cd5986.

Note: this changes how half-cent amounts are rounded for every caller of `round_money`.

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug on a new branch, CI passed, and I opened PR #101 against main with alex as reviewer.

- **Cause:** `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` to round to cents, even though its docstring says it uses banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212).
- **Fix:** On branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` I changed `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. Now 2.665 rounds to 2.66 and 2.675 rounds to 2.68, which is what the test expects.
- **CI:** Run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986.
- **PR:** https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

This changes how half-cent amounts are rounded for every caller of `round_money`, and I noted that in the PR description. I couldn't look up FIN-212 because the advisory tool doesn't recognise it, so the fix relies only on the test and the docstring. The PR hasn't been merged: that needs a code owner's approval.
